independent_integration.method: Prime sieve and integration on every integer interval; independent from the prime-power breakpoint implementation

log_coordinate_identity: F(y)=exp(-y/2) E(exp(y)); R(y)=exp(-2y) J(exp(y)); R'=F^2-2R almost everywhere; R(0)=0
benefit: An exact known global reduction to a positive anchored energy; the arithmetic identity identifies the true coefficients.
limitation: No unconditional bound J=O(X^2) is proved. Positive forcing and positive energy alone are automatic. The equivalence to Weil positivity relies on the true zeta arithmetic/analytic identity; arbitrary finite changes of Lambda preserve the energy class but can change the modified signal sign.
